subject: [AMBER] Gamess small model geometry optimization from MCPB.py output

messages.author: Ralph Roberts
messages.body:
All,
I have the following header commands for my xyz_small_opt.in file as generated by MCPB.py
$SYSTEM MEMDDI=400 MWORDS=200 $END
$CONTRL DFTTYP=B3LYP RUNTYP=OPTIMIZE ICHARG=6 MULT=1 $END
$STATPT NSTEP=1000 $END
$BASIS GBASIS=N31 NGAUSS=6 NDFUNC=1 $END
